cards.title: Solar Oven Picnic Station Paragraph Revision Card
cards.paragraphRevisionSkill: revise one fictional sun-shadow station chart paragraph by improving the topic sentence, detail order, transition, closing sentence, repeated words, and final copy
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable lined paper paragraph revision card for revising one fictional sun-shadow station chart paragraph: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Set lined paper beside this card and choose one pretend sun-shadow station chart moment before the writer starts: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Adult reads: Writer, make one sun-shadow station chart paragraph clearer by changing one part at a time on lined paper: ____________________.
cards.topicSentencePrompt: Adult asks: Write a topic sentence that tells the reader the paragraph is about one sun-shadow station chart: ____________________.
cards.detailOrderPrompt: Adult asks: Number two details so the shadow arrow detail comes before the station notebook detail: ____________________.
cards.transitionCheckPrompt: Adult asks: Add one small transition, such as first or next, so the writer moves from shadow arrow to notebook detail: ____________________.
cards.closingSentencePrompt: Adult asks: Write a closing sentence that brings the paragraph back to the station chart: ____________________.
cards.repeatedWordCutPrompt: Adult asks: Circle one repeated sun word, then replace one copy with a fresh paper word: ____________________.
cards.finalRevisedParagraphPrompt: Adult asks: Copy the final revised paragraph neatly on lined paper with the new topic, details, transition, closing, and word change: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Adult points to one sentence, and the writer changes only that sentence first: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Later paper line: Try the same revision steps with a pretend shadow card or station chart paragraph: ____________________.
